paragraphs: Localintel sells an AI-powered platform that turns data about a community into charts, maps, dashboards, stories, reports, and website embeds. The catalog includes formatted reports on economy, workforce, housing, demographics, and quality of life, exportable as PDFs or share web links. It also produces plain-language narratives that explain what the data means, editable in Word for newsletters, reports, blogs, and board packs.

A separate products page lists interactive data visualization tools that a customer embeds on a website to show a location's strengths. One of those tools helps businesses find commercial properties that are currently for sale or lease. Another shows the universities and colleges supplying talent to businesses in a location.

The pages present the platform to public-sector teams in economic development, planning, communications, parks and recreation, public works, grants, finance, and IT. A case study names Norfolk County, whose team published a data-rich news article in its first week with the platform. The about page says hundreds of communities across the US and Canada use Localintel products.

quote.text: Ready-to-publish location content for government teams
